title: Donut advanced labels retain spacing for a hidden value row

complexity.rationale: The incorrect row-offset branches are confirmed and the fix is a localized application of the existing visible-value predicate across top- and bottom-hemisphere spacing.

summary: Advanced SegmentLabels can retain vertical whitespace for a hidden primary value/percent row. Optional label content should contribute spacing only when that content is rendered.
symptom: When `showValueRow` is enabled but both `value` and `percent` are disabled, a blank vertical gap remains where the hidden primary value row would have appeared. The segment name and detail row do not collapse into a compact two-row block.
rootCause: packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/donut/segmentLabelUtils.ts:804-836 computes rich-label row offsets separately from the correctly conditional block-height calculation. In the top-hemisphere `showValueRow` branch, `getRichSegmentLabelTopRowDy` reserves the primary value font size and name/value gap even when `hasValue` is false. In the bottom hemisphere, `getRichSegmentLabelBottomDetailDy` retains the name/value gap before a detail-only row. Mark creation, collision `minGap`, width measurement, swatch reservation, and total-suffix width already omit their respective disabled content correctly; the defect is limited to the hemisphere-specific row `dy` expressions. The existing detail-only expectation in packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/donut/segmentLabelUtils.test.tsx currently codifies the extra gap.

comparison.aspect: Spacing for optional Advanced label rows
comparison.expected: Only visible rows and the gaps between those visible rows contribute to the label block. A name plus detail row forms a compact two-row block when the primary value/percent row is hidden.
comparison.actual: The hidden primary row still contributes its font height or adjacent gap to the row-position formulas, leaving visible whitespace.

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The detail value sits directly after the name using only the intended gap between the two visible rows.

edgeCases.case: Primary value or percent visible with the detail row
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The existing three-row name/value/detail spacing remains unchanged.
No vertical space is reserved for either value row when both are disabled.
No horizontal swatch width or gap remains; this already-working behavior must not regress.
The total suffix contributes horizontal width only when rendered and does not change unrelated vertical row spacing.
Both hemisphere-specific row stacks remove hidden-row whitespace consistently.

crossCutting.notes: This is a static row-geometry correction using existing font-size signals and visible-row predicates. S1 has no Advanced SegmentLabel implementation to mirror.

implementationPlan.change: Update the rich-label top-row and bottom-detail `dy` helpers so primary value font height and adjacent gaps are included only when `value || percent` is true.

Replace the detail-only expectation that currently includes hidden-row spacing and add a visible-content matrix covering swatch-only, detail-only, value-only, value plus detail, total on/off, and both hemispheres.
implementationPlan.lines: rich SegmentLabel optional-row and position tests
